fixed_by: L129/C38 (2026-08-15) — `rb_obj_as_string`/`rb_inspect` as one prelude rule, plus the `Object#__any_to_s` primitive
note: HANDOFF.md §Known wrong answers 1. CRuby never lets a non-String out of `rb_obj_as_string`: it calls `to_s` and falls back to the default `#<C:0x…>` form when the result is not a String; `rb_inspect` is the same shape one level up, calling `to_s` on a non-String `inspect` result. The model uses whatever came back — so `"#{obj}"` is `"1"`, `[obj].join` raises `no implicit conversion of Integer into String`, and `p obj` raises `String can't be coerced into Integer`. Eight wrong answers here plus four controls. The fix is two small halves: the desugarer's `as_string` (C30) needs a second test (`u = t.to_s; String === u ? u : t.__to_s_slow`), and the prelude twins `__join_slow`/`__puts_slow`/`__print_slow`/`__p_slow` need the same, where `__to_s_slow` already *is* `rb_any_to_s`. `puts`/`print` are deliberately not in the file: the model gates on them today (`__write of a non-String`) and one gate would refuse the whole program — add those two lines with the fix, as the check that the twins were fixed too. | FIXED 2026-08-15 (L129/C38). Extended with the `puts`/`print` lines it deliberately omitted while open (they gated), a nested-bad-`inspect` shape, and three guards for defects found while probing the fix: `Array#to_s`/`Hash#to_s` are `inspect` and so must be tested for *inspect*-purity (the model gated), and `Array#join`'s separator goes through `StringValue` rather than `to_s`, so a redefined `String#to_s` made `["a","b"].join("-")` raise.
